the_odds_api.notes: Official market-standard odds API; quota-bound free tier (500 req/mo).

espn.notes: Public scoreboards publish a moneyline/spread/total odds block; no key, coverage varies by league.

oddsportal.notes: 80+ books, all sports. Listing pages are server-rendered; per-match odds table is partly client-rendered and anti-bot protected - plain HTTP may miss rows.

bovada.notes: Offshore book's public JSON feed; unofficial, may geo-block non-US IPs.

betonline.notes: No public JSON API; best-effort parse of sportsbook listing pages.
